change: Opt-in bounded power-of-two axis/diagonal outline refinement; default complete fine-grid strategy unchanged. No gate or retry ceiling relaxed.
environment: macOS 26.6.2 arm64, AppleClang 21, MacOSX27.0 SDK, KiCad 10.0.2
method: Three prepared-input profiler repetitions per strategy, off then on, serial on same host using fresh qualified schematics. No concurrent compile/test/qualification. No zone/model reuse; OS/catalog caches uncontrolled. Small fixed-order samples, not a statistical benchmark.
timing_scope: model_seconds includes construction with internal checks, excludes input loading, PCB text emission, diagnostics, full gates, audit and rendering. This compares C++ strategies, NOT historical Python or end-to-end speedups.
compile_note: Incremental build succeeded; not separately timed in this batch.

tests.coverage: Spans 0..64 with seven jagged feasibility patterns, bounded/repeatable visits, diagonal island despite failed axes, exceptions, invalid options, failed seeds, both-board independent operation accounting, final estimates and ledger mutations.
repaired_failures: Stored schematic stale +3V3_AUX net; test now authors fresh 37-sheet schematic with persistent reference bands

rejected_experiment.configuration: unseeded default carrier placement, multiscale outline
rejected_experiment.decision: Reject area regression; keep multiscale opt-in, not default. Local search is not exhaustive or globally optimal.

limitations: Both boards retain nonmandatory return_path, golden and contract_coverage_lint FAIL reports; no waivers introduced.
Carrier exactly at reseat ceiling 18; no retry headroom.
Off screens exceed retry limits and are not qualified builds despite matching PCB geometry.
168x160 is an existing separately qualified candidate, not a further size improvement caused by this search change.
Bottom component count is not area utilisation; assembly/thermal unknowns remain.
Routing out of scope; no fabrication readiness claim.
Full wall time dominated by source auditing; historical matched-workload Python comparison remains separate and incomplete.
